name: GTD Brain
description: Hosted Getting Things Done (GTD) board: capture to Inbox, next actions by context, projects, waiting-for and weekly review, synced in real time with the GTD Brain web, iOS and Android apps. 16 tools and 4 prompts; sign in with an email code (OAuth 2.1). A new account gets a few free tool calls, then a GTD Brain subscription is required.
author: Minosin AB
